import paddle
import paddle.nn as nn

class DL_Model(nn.Layer):
    def __init__(self):
        super(DL_Model, self).__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2D(in_channels=3, out_channels=64, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1)
        self.relu1 = nn.ReLU()
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2D(in_channels=64 + 3, out_channels=128, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1)
        self.relu2 = nn.ReLU()
        self.conv3 = nn.Conv2D(in_channels=128 + 64 + 3, out_channels=256, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1)
        self.flatten = nn.Flatten()
        self.linear1 = nn.Linear(in_features=256 * 32 * 32, out_features=128)
        self.linear2 = nn.Linear(in_features=128, out_features=10)

    def forward(self, x):
        # the initial shape of x is: (1, 3, 32, 32)
        x = self.relu1(self.conv1(x))  # output tensor shape: (1, 64, 32, 32)
        x = paddle.concat([x, x], axis=1)  # output tensor shape: (1, 128, 32, 32)
        x = self.relu2(self.conv2(x))
        x = paddle.concat([x, self.relu1(self.conv1(x)), x], axis=1)
        x = self.conv3(x)
        x = self.relu2(x)
        x = self.flatten(x)
        x = self.linear1(x)
        x = self.linear2(x)
        return x

if __name__ == "__main__":
    model = DL_Model()
    input_tensor = paddle.randn(shape=[1, 3, 32, 32])
    output_tensor = model(input_tensor)
    print(output_tensor.shape)
